comment: v5.5 patches (after settings-v5.4.json): LAN room discovery for the room host (Android APK hot-update). ① server/index.js gains GET /lan/rooms and GET /lan/room?code=, gated on the socket peer being loopback/private (reuses net.js isLocalIp/normalizeIp -- X-Forwarded-For / CF-Connecting-IP are never consulted, so a public request cannot masquerade as a LAN peer); a public peer and an unknown code share one identical 404 body, so the response never leaks whether a room exists. ② /lan/rooms does NOT enumerate every room: it lists only codes the host explicitly published via POST /lan/publish (review finding #1 -- unconditional listing let any device on the same Wi-Fi join without an invitation). /lan/publish is accepted only from a loopback peer (the host's own page) and only for a room that exists; the set self-heals when a room disappears. /lan/room?code= stays available to private peers without opt-in: it answers yes/no for a code the caller already knows (the invite-code path). ③ a second fixed-port listener (LAN_DISCOVERY_PORT = 32123) is started inside startServer() after the main listen, serving only the two READ-ONLY routes, reusing one shared handler; it swallows EADDRINUSE (owner server must never fail to boot) and unref()s itself. All additions live inside the startServer() call path only -- no module-top-level Node API is added, so the Cloudflare Workers build input is unaffected. Only server/index.js is modified.
